body: R11 SOURCE-SURFACE FOLLOW-UP — scope evidence only, not a disposition or implementation claim. I rechecked committed HEAD 56c38ebe; the source paths below are unchanged from my earlier 9a29cd53 measurement, with only Mote operations added between those commits. Resolver.collect in acquire/resolve.scala:333-346 performs first-wins distinctBy on EvidenceId. An acquire-only repair would leave the authority relation open elsewhere: core/claim.scala:29-35 exposes Evidence as public product data with a caller-supplied id; codec/core.scala:224-229 decodes id and content directly; document/compiler.scala:481-518 admits ById or Inline evidence against the ledger. The five current compiler calls to Resolver.resolve are order-normalized only by the private canonicalBundle at compiler.scala:736-772, so that convention cannot establish the public resolver contract. Accepted evidence later feeds materialization and ClaimId construction at compiler.scala:1298-1342. Therefore the eventual R11 bead should name the identity-to-content admission relation and ledger join before assigning exact edits; scoping it to resolve.scala alone would fix ordering while leaving forgery and conflicting rehydration possible. The existing court surface crosses acquire ProposalSuite and ResolveSuite, core ClaimSuite and ConstructionProbeSuite, codec CodecSuite and CodecGens, and document CompilerSuite. This supports the chief failure shape already stated: identity conflict or unverifiable ById/Inline equivalence yields typed Unresolved and no canonical projection or admission witness. Exact public names, paths, and gate still await the chief bead. No edit, claim, reservation, vocabulary, or authority taken.
